zh.title: 白宮稱 VC-25B Bridge 專機深圳直飛返美創兩項紀錄 航程近15小時
zh.summary: 白宮表示，由卡達贈送的波音 747-8 改裝而成的 VC-25B Bridge 專機，11月19日自深圳不落地直飛安德魯斯聯合基地，創下美國空軍最重起飛與空軍一號最長直飛兩項紀錄。美國空軍與波音尚未證實相關數字。
body: 軍事媒體 TWZ 報導，美國總統川普結束在深圳舉行的亞太經合會（APEC）峰會行程後，搭乘 VC-25B Bridge 專機返美。白宮隨行記者團的通報指出，專機於深圳當地時間11月19日下午5時54分起飛，美東時間晚間8時01分降落馬里蘭州安德魯斯聯合基地，中途沒有落地加油。這架專機由卡達贈送的波音 747-8 改裝而成。
白宮在機上發給記者的卡片寫道，這架 VC-25B「以略低於100萬磅的重量完成空軍史上最重的一次起飛」，並完成「至今最長的空軍一號不落地飛行，航程近15小時」。卡片並載明，專機以3萬3,000呎高度、平均500節的速度飛越太平洋，途經上海、東京、阿拉斯加謝米亞、溫尼伯與克里夫蘭上空。川普則說這趟飛行約14個半小時。
TWZ 表示已請美國空軍與波音證實上述數字；Simple Flying 指出，兩項紀錄目前只有白宮方面的說法。TWZ 指出，VC-25B 所本的 747-8i 最大起飛重量為98萬7,000磅，常見引用的最長續航時間為15至16小時；深圳至安德魯斯約7,500浬的航程，仍在波音公布的民航版 747-8i 近7,800浬航程之內。
這架過渡專機不能空中加油，波音依合約將交付的兩架 VC-25B 也沒有這項能力；TWZ 報導，空中加油需求已在2017年為節省成本而取消。現役兩架 VC-25A 具備空中加油能力，但只在緊急情況使用，這次任務中兩機返程先在阿拉斯加落地加油。TWZ 並指出，VC-25B 的航程需求已由約7,100浬下修為5,900浬，除非實際性能大幅超出需求，否則無法重複這次的不落地航程。

en.title: White House says VC-25B Bridge jet set two records on nonstop flight home from Shenzhen
en.summary: The White House said the VC-25B Bridge aircraft, a modified Boeing 747-8 gifted by Qatar, flew nonstop from Shenzhen to Joint Base Andrews on November 19, making the heaviest takeoff in Air Force history and the longest nonstop Air Force One flight. The Air Force and Boeing have not confirmed the figures.
body: TWZ reported that President Donald Trump returned to the United States aboard the VC-25B Bridge aircraft after the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen. According to the White House press pool report, the jet took off at 5:54 p.m. Shenzhen time on November 19 and landed at Joint Base Andrews, Maryland, at 8:01 p.m. Eastern time with no refueling stop. The aircraft is a modified Boeing 747-8 gifted by Qatar.

A card handed to reporters on board said the VC-25B “conducted the heaviest takeoff in Air Force history, at just under one million pounds, and completed the longest, nonstop Air Force One sortie to date, at nearly 15 hours.” The card said the aircraft crossed the Pacific at 33,000 feet at an average of 500 knots, passing over Shanghai, Tokyo, Shemya in Alaska, Winnipeg and Cleveland. Trump put the duration at about fourteen and a half hours.

TWZ said it has asked the Air Force and Boeing to confirm the figures, and Simple Flying noted that the White House remains the only source for the two records. TWZ noted that the 747-8i on which the VC-25B is based has a maximum takeoff weight of 987,000 pounds and a commonly quoted endurance of 15 to 16 hours, and that the roughly 7,500 nautical miles flown is within the nearly 7,800 nautical miles Boeing lists for the commercial 747-8i.

The Bridge jet cannot be refueled in flight, and neither can the two VC-25Bs Boeing is under contract to deliver; TWZ reported that the requirement was dropped in 2017 to cut costs. The two VC-25As in service can refuel in the air, though only in emergencies, and on this mission they stopped in Alaska to refuel before returning home. TWZ added that the VC-25B range requirement was revised from about 7,100 to 5,900 nautical miles, so the new jets could not repeat this nonstop flight unless they substantially exceed it.

facts.claim: Air Force One left Shenzhen at 5:54 p.m. local time and landed at Joint Base Andrews at 8:01 p.m. EST with no refueling stop, per the White House press pool.
A White House card claimed the heaviest takeoff in Air Force history at just under one million pounds and the longest nonstop Air Force One sortie at nearly 15 hours.
TWZ asked the Air Force and Boeing to confirm; the 747-8i has a 987,000 lb MTOW and the 7,500 nm flight is within its nearly 7,800 nm range.
Neither the Bridge jet nor the future VC-25Bs can refuel in flight; the range requirement was revised from about 7,100 to 5,900 nm.
The White House remains the only source for the two record claims.
